name: Spreadsheet
description: Open and edit Excel and OpenDocument spreadsheets in Orca's editor: cells, formulas, rows and columns, with undo. Saves .xlsx, .xlsm and .ods in place, keeping their formatting.

cover.alt: A quarterly summary workbook being edited: East's revenue changed and the totals recalculated, and a formula typed into a new Target column

screenshots.alt: Two rows selected with the cell menu open: insert rows above or below, delete rows, insert or delete columns, clear contents
screenshots.caption: Insert and delete rows and columns

screenshots.alt: A 50,000-row data sheet with a block of cells selected and its count, sum and average in the status bar
screenshots.caption: Large sheets scroll smoothly

screenshots.alt: The summary workbook in Orca's dark theme after an edit, with the changed revenue, recalculated totals and a #DIV/0! error in red
screenshots.caption: Follows Orca's dark theme
